ambiguities_or_notes: по случаю сражения 4-го is translated 'after the battle of the 4th'; the editorial note identifies it as the battle at the Chernaya River on 4 August 1855.
Горная артилерия is kept as 'Mountain Artillery,' matching the military branch rather than generalized to artillery.
Дюссо is rendered 'Dussot'; external historical sources also attest Dussot as the name of the well-known Petersburg restaurant, while the source note itself identifies it as a restaurant.
The afterthought about literary matters is kept after the signature as in the source.
